title: Thread tests: barrier sync masks actual concurrency bugs
description: test/wp11_test_pkcs11_threads.c uses pthread_barrier_wait() to synchronize thread launch. This ensures all threads start at the same point but does not create true concurrency -- threads proceed sequentially through barriers with deterministic interleaving. Race conditions between barrier exit and the first lock acquisition are never exercised. Fix: remove barriers and add random short delays, or run the same test hundreds of times under TSan (Thread Sanitizer) to catch data races.
